headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal to sign Mexico's Gilberto Mora?

headline: Alexander Isak, Cody Gakpo in doubt for Liverpool vs. Man City clash
description: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola has cast doubt on the chances of Alexander Isak and Cody Gakpo being fit to face Manchester City this weekend.

headline: Another bad Man United run has Carrick feeling the heat. Should he be?
description: Michael Carrick is hardly unique in that he brought hope to Man United, but is he on course to become the latest coach to be fired midseason?

headline: Tottenham's Mathys Tel equals France under-21 goalscoring record
description: Mathys Tel will be hoping to take his goal-scoring exploits with France Under-21s over the international break into Tottenham's fight to turn their Premier League season around.

headline: We don't get Man City guilty verdict without hacker Rui Pinto, but it doesn't make him a hero
description: The Manchester City case, which has rocked English football to its core, wouldn't have been possible without Football Leaks and its founder, Rui Pinto. However, he is a complicated figure, with light and dark to his actions.
